subject: SIG-lite + subprocessor & data provenance request — NovaMed review
messages:
From: NovaMed Security <security@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG-lite + subprocessor & data provenance request for NovaMed procurement review

Jordan —

As part of our procurement security review for the next phase of integration, NovaMed's security team is collecting a SIG-lite and an inventory of all subprocessors that handle customer data for inference-related features. We need the following scoped to Redwood's hosted and dedicated inference paths:

- Completed SIG-lite questions (CSV/PDF) or a point-by-point QA.
- A current subprocessor inventory (name, primary service, data categories processed, country).
- A simple data provenance diagram showing where PII/PHI might touch Redwood systems for model inference, caching, or logs.
- Any KMS/HSM partners that hold keys for customer-managed deployment.

Requested delivery: by Friday 2026-04-09 EOD Pacific. If you cannot meet that window, propose an alternative with milestones.

Please include any artifacts (CSV, diagrams, attestation docs) as attachments or share a secure Drive link. We will route the artifacts to procurement and the InfoSec committee.

Thanks,
Aaron Chen
Security Analyst, NovaMed
security@novamed.com

Attachment: none

Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-lite + subprocessor & data provenance request for NovaMed procurement review

Aaron —

Thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. Quick plan:

- I'll assemble a SIG-lite export and a curated subprocessor CSV that covers hosted + dedicated paths.
- Marissa (copied) will validate the dataflow diagram and KMS notes.
- We will upload the artifacts to a secure Drive folder and send a link by Friday EOD PT.

Can you confirm the scope excludes on-prem/private deployment inventory? That will affect whether we include certain managed-hosting subcontractors.

If Friday is hard, we can deliver the CSV + diagram on Friday and follow up with the signed SIG-lite PDF early next week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Can you pull the most recent subprocessor inventory filtered for: (a) "inference runtime" providers, (b) caching/kv vendors, and (c) key management partners used by private deployments? NovaMed is explicitly asking to exclude on-prem customers, but include dedicated (reserved capacity) partners.

Output needed by EOD PT Thursday (2026-04-08): CSV with columns: vendor_name, service_description, data_categories, region, contract_start, contract_review_doc (link or ref). Also attach the existing dataflow diagram (redwood_dataflow_diagram_v2.png) if you have the annotated copy.

Note: we want to avoid over-disclosure—stick to high-level descriptions and the categories of data processed (e.g., request_text, model_cache_tokens, telemetry). Don't include customer names or specific account IDs.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Trust & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Aaron / NovaMed procurement —

Thanks for the patience. Attached and shared below are the artifacts scoped to Redwood's hosted and dedicated inference paths (we have not included on-prem/private deployments per your scope):

Summary of deliverables attached:
- redwood_subprocessors_2026-04.csv — curated inventory (vendor name, service, data categories, country).
- redwood_dataflow_diagram_v2.png — high-level data provenance (where request_text, model_cache, and telemetry may be processed).
- SIG-lite-response-Redwood-2026-04.pdf — point-by-point SIG-lite answers for the requested sections.

Key notes:
- KMS/HSM partners: For hosted customers we manage keys in our KMS; for Dedicated and Private we support customer-managed keys (we list the third-party HSM/KMS integrations in the CSV).
- Caching: We describe transient model KV caches and retention policies in the SIG-lite. No long-term storage of raw request text outside of customer-configured logs.
- Subprocessors marked as "restricted" in the CSV are only used in Dedicated or Managed-hosting contexts and are listed with region and data category tags.

Secure Drive link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExAMPLElink
HubSpot reference: HUBSPOT-Deal-54671

Let us know if the procurement team needs a signed attestation or additional export formats (Excel, encrypted container). We can also schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week with Marissa and our security engineering lead.

Best regards,
Jordan Blake
